section: BAR §7 — sealing caps and terminators from TOPOLOGY, not branchCount
contract: Model the objects separately: branch terminator (actual cable ends), occupied connector/drop, unused connector/drop, unused-connector sealing cap, branch starting/ending connector. Terminators = actual required cable-end objects. Sealing caps = actual unused connector/drop objects. Connectors = occupied drops. BOM + evidence list the source object IDs.

occupiedConnectors.basis: 31 modules = 31 microinverters = 31 occupied drops (B1 11 / B2 10 / B3 10), read from the branch objects — not a per-branch constant.

terminators.basis: one per branch cable FAR-END (the end away from the J-box transition) — the quantity happens to equal the branch count because each branch has exactly one far end, but it is DERIVED from the enumerated cable-end objects, not from branches.length.
renderedRow: Terminator (branch end, single-use) — one per branch cable FAR-END (away from the J-box transition). Cable-end objects: B1-END, B2-END, B3-END

sealingCaps.priorState: 3 caps, justified as "service-loop unused drops (1 per AC branch)" — a per-branch constant with no topology behind it.
sealingCaps.derivation: Q Cable is procured BY DROP (Q-12-10-240, soldBy: drop): 31 drops ordered = 31 micros = 31 occupied drops ⇒ the drop-count procurement model establishes 0 surplus connectors. The resolver models no fixed-length cable sections, so the number of UNUSED connectors on the pieces actually cut cannot be established from the current authority.
sealingCaps.honestOutcome: Rather than invent a cap count, the row renders QUANTITY PENDING (topology-derived, NOT 1-per-branch) with its full derivation. Gate 9 accepts the recorded PENDING state and FAILS any topology-independent (per-branch) quantity.
renderedRow: Sealing Cap (unused connector) — QUANTITY PENDING (topology-derived, NOT 1-per-branch): 31 drops ordered = 31 micros = 31 occupied drops; drop-count procurement establishes 0 surplus connectors (resolver models no fixed-section pieces). Field service-loop / dead-drop caps depend on cable routing — determine at field verification.
sealingCaps.clearsWhen: a fixed-section cable-piece inventory (or an operator-entered cut list) makes ordered-connectors − occupied-drops determinate.

boundary: No fabricated source, grounding authority, fastener SKU or manufacturer evidence. Every state below is the state the code actually produced; honest PENDING/UNVERIFIED states are recorded as such, not resolved.
